captions.detailed: A tower-mounted cantilever tooling arm featuring a dark gray or black cylindrical tower base anchored to a rectangular plate. Extending horizontally from the top of the tower is a long, light-gray rectangular upper link, followed by a shorter middle link connected via a revolute joint. The arm terminates in a narrow, dark-gray wrist cartridge and a flat, square faceplate. This multi-link robotic arm articulates via three serial revolute joints, allowing horizontal rotation at the base, elbow, and wrist.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a tower-mounted cantilever tooling arm. The assembly should feature a dark-colored vertical support tower on a rectangular base plate, a long light-gray primary link, a shorter secondary link, and a dark-colored wrist cartridge ending in a square faceplate, all connected by serial revolute joints.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by building individual links as parts of an ArticulatedObject. The base tower is modeled with a rectangular support plate, a vertical cylindrical column, and a small side bracket. The upper link is created from a long rectangular extrusion with a rounded pivot cap at the tower connection. The forelink is modeled as a shorter rectangular tube ending in a U-shaped fork. The wrist cartridge is constructed from a narrow cylinder and a thin square faceplate. These components are sequentially positioned and linked using three revolute joints.
